'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Brad Eier LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' SS-19
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
